entrance: In the northwest corner of Tanaris, at /way 39 20, at the end of a canyon northwest of Gadgetzan.

2936.objective: Read the Tablet of Theka, next to Theka the Martyr, to learn the name of the spider god.
2936.note: The chain starts with a Venom Bottle that lies in the troll camps of The Hinterlands, and runs through Apothecary Lydon in the Alterac Mountains.

2991.objective: Kill Nekrum Gutchewer in the stairs event and bring back Nekrum's Medallion.
2991.note: The chain starts with Witherbark Cages from Gryphon Master Talonaxe in Aerie Peak, The Hinterlands. After this quest, it goes on in the Blasted Lands and The Hinterlands.

2768.objective: Bring back the Divino-matic Rod. Sergeant Bly drops it at the end of the stairs event.

2865.objective: Collect 5 Uncracked Scarab Shells from the Scarabs inside the dungeon.
2865.note: The Scarabs are not elite and only attack when you hit them. Krazek in Booty Bay has an optional quest that sends you to Tran'rek.

3042.objective: Collect 20 Vials of Troll Temper from the elite trolls inside the dungeon.

2846.objective: Bring back the Tiara of the Deep. Hydromancer Velratha drops it.
2846.note: Mage trainers in the cities give Tabetha's Task, an optional quest that sends you to Tabetha.

2770.objective: Summon Gahz'rilla at the pool and bring back Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale.
2770.note: One player needs the Mallet of Zul'Farrak to ring the gong. The Brassbolts Brothers, from Klockmort Spannerspan in Tinker Town, sends the Alliance here.

3527.objective: Bring back the First Mosh'aru Tablet from Theka the Martyr and the Second Mosh'aru Tablet from Hydromancer Velratha.
3527.note: First complete Screecher Spirits: kill Vale Screechers in Feralas, use Yeh'kinya's Bramble on the corpse and talk to the spirit, three times. The chain continues towards the Sunken Temple.
